{{MissingInfo|1|enva}} {{AnimePokémonInfobox| type1=Water| type2=Grass| ball=None| nickname=Lombre| jnickname=ハスブレロ| tmnickname=Hasubrero| image=[[File:Lombre RTDX.png|300px]]| caption=The {{pkmn2|hero}} and [[Partner Pokémon (Mystery Dungeon)|partner]] speaking to Lombre in [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX|Rescue Team DX]].| caught=no | gender=Male | ability=Unknown| pokemonname=Lombre| prevonum=271| epnum= Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team | current=At [[Pokémon Square]] | media=anime| java1=[[List of Japanese voice actors|Kenjirō Tsuda]] | enva1=Unknown| }} '''Lombre''' (Japanese: '''ハスブレロ''' ''Hasubrero'') is a [[non-player character]] in [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team, Blue Rescue Team]] and their [[remake]], [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX|Rescue Team DX]]. ==In the games== [[File:Lombre PMD RTRB.png|thumb|Lombre in [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team|Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team]]|left]] Lombre is a resident of [[Pokémon Square]] who is friendly with the {{pkmn2|hero}} and [[Partner Pokémon (Mystery Dungeon)|partner]]. He was hesitant in attacking the hero when the residents were told that the hero was causing the natural disasters but did so anyway (though he does not attack them in the remake). He then took part in the chase of them. He was happy to find out that they were cleared of all charges and welcomed them back. When {{mdc|Shiftry|1}} called lots of rescue teams together, Lombre stopped the hero and their partner volunteering to go and fight {{p|Groudon}} as there were more experienced rescue teams there. Lombre was later at [[Hill of the Ancients]] where he celebrated with the hero and partner when they helped to get the falling star destroyed. After the credits roll, Lombre is part of the conversations that let the player unlock [[Stormy Sea]]. He can also tell the team about [[Buried Relic]]'s buried items when it becomes the focus of the Pokémon Square's talk. {{left clear}} ===Appearance=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{grass color dark}}; background: #{{water color}}; font-size:80%;" |- |style="{{roundy|80px}} border: 2px solid #{{grass color dark}}; background: #{{water color light}}; width:240px"| [[File:MDP RT 271.png]][[File:MDP RT 271 Joyous.png]][[File:MDP RT 271 Angry.png]][[File:MDP RT 271 Teary-eyed.png]] |style="{{roundy|80px}} border: 2px solid #{{grass color dark}}; background: #{{water color light}}; width:240px"| [[File:MDP RTDX 271.png|40px]][[File:MDP RTDX 271 Grin.png|40px]][[File:MDP RTDX 271 Pained.png|40px]][[File:MDP RTDX 271 Angry.png|40px]][[File:MDP RTDX 271 Astounded.png|40px]]

{{color2|000|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Rescue Team DX|Rescue Team DX}} |} ==In the manga== ===In the Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Ginji's Rescue Team manga=== Lombre appeared in ''[[GRT2|I Want to be Human Again!]]''. {{sectionstub}} ==In animation== [[File:Snubbull Lombre PMD anime.png|thumb|220px|Lombre in ''[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!]]'']] In ''[[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Team Go-Getters Out of the Gate!]]'', Lombre was at [[Whiscash Pond]] together with {{p|Bellsprout}}, {{OBP|Snubbull|Red and Blue Rescue Team}}, and {{OBP|Whiscash|Red and Blue Rescue Team}}. Along with the others, he overheard a {{p|Pichu}}'s worries about his older brother {{p|Pikachu}}. When [[Team Meanies]] showed up and proposed to rescue Pikachu, Lombre discussed with Bellsprout and Snubbull what the {{OBP|Rank|Mystery Dungeon}} of Team Meanies would be.
